description: Delete a product by id; Zuora enforces references and vendor-role permissions. (DELETE /v1/object/product/{product_id}). Returns job_id/status queued at once; dispatch is not completion.
embedding_description: Delete a product by id; Zuora enforces references and vendor-role permissions. Use this typed Zuora catalog operation with the registered tenant OAuth client. Vendor RBAC governs permission; completion reports the vendor result and any continuation, while queued means accepted for background work only.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job envelope; completion carries operation, method, path, status, correlation_id, data and pagination where the vendor pages.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Queued is not completion. Relay vendor ids, states and errors exactly. Catalog mutations and deletes are first-class; never automatically replay a write.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Delete a product by id; Zuora enforces references and vendor-role permissions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params means the request fails the documented shape; zuora.auth_failed is a 401; zuora.permission_denied is the registered role's 403. zuora.validation_failed includes vendor preconditions or success false; zuora.object_not_found, zuora.rate_limited and zuora.api_error preserve the vendor failure class.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct parameters or vendor catalog state; read current state before retrying a write. Preserve vendor reasons and any stale-write or reference refusal. Ask the tenant administrator for missing catalog permissions or enabled features; never retry deletes automatically.
